title: AthenaSIP configuration
description: Generated by athenasip --print-schema. docs/configuration.md explains each section.

sip.description: The node, and how it treats SIP.

node_id.description: This node's name. Unique in the cluster.

public_address.description: The address this node tells others to reach it on. Needed in a container, behind NAT or a balancer; empty falls back to the bind address, or to one peers have seen this node at.

localnet.description: Prefixes on this node's side of the router, such as 192.168.0.0/16. A far end inside them is given the local address and port; everyone else the public ones.

allow_unencrypted.description: False refuses to start with a udp, tcp or plain websocket listener.

forward_register.description: A REGISTER for a domain this node does not serve (RFC 3261 10.3): subscribers forwards one from this node's own subscribers; never answers 403.

log_messages.description: Log every message in full, not only its first line. Credentials are redacted.

session_expires.description: RFC 4028: the session interval, in seconds, put on a call that asked for none. 0 inserts none.

session_min_se.description: RFC 4028: the shortest session interval a call may negotiate, in seconds.

require_session_timer.description: Add Require: timer when the caller did not. NOT RECOMMENDED by RFC 4028: every call to an endpoint without the extension fails.

max_call_duration.description: The longest any call is held, in seconds; each end is then sent a BYE. 0 is no limit. It cuts live calls too.

media_timeout.description: Seconds an anchored call may carry no media before each end is sent a BYE. 0 turns it off. RTCP counts, so a call on hold is not silent.

connect_timeout_ms.description: How long opening a connection to a next hop may take, in milliseconds.

flow_idle_timeout.description: Seconds a UDP flow may sit idle before it is forgotten. 0 never forgets. Keep it above 32 (64 * T1).

timers.description: The RFC 3261 section 17 timers. a to k are multiples of T1 or T4, not milliseconds. Leave them alone.

t1_rtt_ms.description: T1, the round-trip estimate, in milliseconds.

t2_max_retransmit_interval_ms.description: T2, the longest retransmit interval, in milliseconds.

t4_network_propagation_ms.description: T4, the longest a message stays in the network, in milliseconds.

a_invite_initial.description: Timer A, the first INVITE retransmit, in T1.

b_invite_timeout.description: Timer B, the INVITE transaction timeout, in T1.

d_invite_duration.description: Timer D, the wait for response retransmits, in T1.

e_non_invite_initial.description: Timer E, the first non-INVITE retransmit, in T1.

f_non_invite_timeout.description: Timer F, the non-INVITE transaction timeout, in T1.

g_server_invite_initial.description: Timer G, the first INVITE response retransmit, in T1.

h_server_invite_timeout.description: Timer H, the wait for an ACK, in T1.

i_server_invite_duration.description: Timer I, the wait for ACK retransmits, in T4.

j_server_non_invite_duration.description: Timer J, the wait for non-INVITE retransmits, in T1.

k_non_invite_duration.description: Timer K, the wait for response retransmits, in T4.

c_invite_proxy_ms.description: Timer C, how long a proxied INVITE may ring, in milliseconds. Over three minutes (RFC 3261 16.6 step 11).

udp.description: SIP over UDP. No section, no listener.

enable.description: A listener whose section is present is enabled unless this is false.

port.description: The port to bind. Required unless enable is false.

public_port.description: The port a router forwards to this listener, for what the node tells others. 0 is the bound port.

tcp.description: SIP over TCP. No section, no listener.

enable.description: A listener whose section is present is enabled unless this is false.

port.description: The port to bind. Required unless enable is false.

public_port.description: The port a router forwards to this listener, for what the node tells others. 0 is the bound port.

tls.description: SIP over TLS. No section, no listener.

enable.description: A listener whose section is present is enabled unless this is false.

port.description: The port to bind. Required unless enable is false.

public_port.description: The port a router forwards to this listener, for what the node tells others. 0 is the bound port.

websocket.description: SIP over WebSocket (RFC 7118), for browsers. No section, no listener.

enable.description: A listener whose section is present is enabled unless this is false.

port.description: The port to bind. Required unless enable is false.

public_port.description: The port a router forwards to this listener, for what the node tells others. 0 is the bound port.

tls.description: Serve wss on port. Needs this section's own certificate and key. A page served over https can only use wss.

secure_port.description: A second, wss listener beside a plain one. 0 is none. Unused when tls is true.

cert_pem_filename.description: The wss certificate, PEM. Empty uses the tls section's.

key_pem_filename.description: The wss certificate's key, PEM. Empty uses the tls section's.

cluster.description: The inter-node listener: mutual TLS under the cluster CA (docs/certificates.md).

enable.description: Join a cluster. Needs a shared datastore, an event bus, and ca, cert and key.

advertise.description: What other nodes dial. The node's certificate must name it. Empty is the bind address, or sip.public_address on a wildcard bind.

ca.description: The cluster CA's certificate, from athenasip --ca-init.

datastore.description: Where users, registrations and calls are kept. Each driver may have a section of its own here, named after it.

url.description: memory:// keeps nothing over a restart and serves one node; a cluster shares redis://.

events.description: The event bus: observability, presence and discovery. Each driver may have a section of its own here.

url.description: local:// stays in this process; nodes find each other over mqtt://.

status_interval.description: Seconds between this node's status reports on the bus. 0 reports once.

mqtt.description: The mqtt:// event bus. The URL names the broker; this says how to talk to it.

client_id.description: The MQTT client identifier, unique on the broker. Empty is athenasip-<sip.node_id>.

connect_timeout_ms.description: How long startup waits for the broker before failing, in milliseconds.

username.description: The broker username, if not in the URL.

password.description: The broker password, if not in the URL.

prefix.description: Put before every topic, so clusters can share a broker.

media.description: The media engine that relays calls. Each driver may have a section of its own here.

url.description: builtin:// relays RTP; WebRTC (ICE, DTLS, SRTP) needs rtpengine://host:port.

builtin.description: The builtin:// relay: plain RTP from the node's own process.

public_address.description: The address written into SDP, which endpoints must reach: on a host behind NAT, the public one. May be a host name, resolved at start and every minute.

port_min.description: The bottom of the RTP port range. Behind NAT, forward the whole range.

port_max.description: The top of the RTP port range. Above port_min, or both take their defaults.

rtpengine.description: The rtpengine:// media engine, over its ng control port.

engines.description: More engines, as host or host:port, making a pool with the URL's. A call stays on the engine it started on.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for one ng reply before asking again, in milliseconds.

attempts.description: Tries per request. An engine that answers none of them leaves the pool until it answers a ping.

ping_interval.description: Seconds between pings of every engine.

media_address.description: The address rtpengine advertises. Empty leaves it to rtpengine's interfaces. A leg inside sip.localnet is given the node's local address.

policy.description: Who may call, and where a request goes. Each driver may have a section of its own here.

url.description: builtin:// serves this node's realms and nothing more, with no script.

push.description: RFC 8599 push notifications. Off with no urls. Each driver may have a section of its own here.

urls.description: One push service per entry: apns://, fcm://, webpush://.

timeout.description: Seconds a request waits for the client to re-register after a push (RFC 8599 5.6.2).

refresh.description: Seconds before a push binding expires that a push asks the client to refresh it (RFC 8599 5.5). A push binding must then ask for at least this plus 60.

apns.description: Apple Push Notification service, for apns:// in push.urls.

key_file.description: The APNs key Apple issues (AuthKey_<key ID>.p8).

environment.description: sandbox for an app built for development.

ttl.description: Seconds APNs keeps trying to deliver the push. 0 is now or not at all.

api_base.description: Only to go through a proxy: an https URL. Empty follows environment.

ca_file.description: More CA certificates to trust, beside the system's.

fcm.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging, for fcm:// in push.urls.

service_account.description: The service-account JSON file the Firebase console gives you.

ttl.description: Seconds FCM keeps trying to deliver the push.

api_base.description: Only to go through a proxy.

ca_file.description: More CA certificates to trust, beside the system's.

webpush.description: Web Push (RFC 8030) with VAPID (RFC 8292), for webpush:// in push.urls.

vapid_private_key.description: A P-256 private key, PEM: openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out vapid.pem.

subject.description: A mailto: or https: URI a push service can reach you at.

ttl.description: Seconds the push service keeps trying.

ca_file.description: More CA certificates to trust, beside the system's.

behaviour.description: The defaults for what differs between SIP servers. A realm overrides any of them over the API.

media_anchor.description: Relay media through the media engine. False leaves it end to end, which fails behind NAT.

media_profile.description: What each leg's media is offered as: mirror gives each leg what it offered; the others are explained in docs/behaviour.md.

qualify_interval.description: Seconds between OPTIONS to a registered client. 0 is never.

rewrite_contact.description: Rewrite a registering client's Contact to the address it was seen at.

log.description: What the node logs, and how.

format.description: One line of text per message, or one JSON object.

history_retention.description: Seconds an ended call's record is kept. 0 keeps records for ever.

http.description: The admin API, the console and the file server. No section, no listener.

tls.description: An HTTPS listener beside the plain one. Browsers give the microphone only to a secure page.

address.description: The address to bind. Empty is http.address.

cert_pem_filename.description: The certificate, PEM. Empty uses the tls section's.

key_pem_filename.description: The certificate's key, PEM. Empty uses the tls section's.

enable.description: Serve the API when its section is present.

session_lifetime.description: An admin session's absolute lifetime, in seconds.

session_idle.description: How long an admin session may sit unused, in seconds. 0 turns the check off.

ice_servers.description: STUN and TURN URLs handed to web clients, each a URL or a map with url. They do not affect this node's own media.

turn_shared_secret.description: The secret shared with the TURN server (coturn's static-auth-secret), from which expiring credentials are minted. Empty serves turn: URLs without credentials.

turn_credential_ttl.description: How long a minted TURN credential lasts, in seconds.

rate_limits.description: A burst allowance, then a rate per minute. 0 in either turns that limit off.

open.description: Open routes, unknown endpoints and credentials that do not resolve, by source address.

per_minute.description: Requests allowed per minute after that.
Requests allowed per minute after that.
Requests allowed per minute after that.
Requests allowed per minute after that.

files.description: A static file server, for the console.

enable.description: Serve files when the section is present.

spa.description: Answer a path that matches no file with index.html, so a single-page app's routes survive a reload. Never for /api/ or a path with a file extension.
